purpose: Name and type the boundary-conditioned admissible-deviation evaluation without colliding with existing delta_a, delta_alpha, or epsilon_a meanings.

symbol_decision.reason: Existing delta and epsilon symbols already carry governed admissibility-filter, RT-core, deviation, or local-floor meanings. The named operator makes the new role explicit without silent rebinding.

formal_signature.diagnostic_form: DevAdm_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) = ADMISSIBLE iff omega remains admissible under the declared boundary and relational domain.

definition.candidate_rule: DevAdm_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) := EvaluateOrientationDeviation(B_x, omega, D_rel)
definition.admissible_condition: DevAdm_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) = ADMISSIBLE iff the orientation-conditioned deviation satisfies the declared admissibility constraints of D_rel.
definition.inadmissible_condition: DevAdm_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) = INADMISSIBLE iff the declared constraints reject the orientation-conditioned deviation.
definition.undefined_condition: DevAdm_x returns UNDEFINED when B_x, omega, D_rel, or the admissibility constraints are untyped or unavailable.
definition.no_repair_rule: The evaluator classifies the supplied inputs and does not repair, replace, or construct a boundary, orientation, domain, or deviation.

relationship_to_existing_symbols.delta_a: Unchanged. DevAdm_x may supply an orientation-specific admissibility result to a separately governed filter, but it does not replace delta_a.
relationship_to_existing_symbols.delta_alpha: Unchanged and unresolved. No compatibility or signature identity is asserted.
relationship_to_existing_symbols.epsilon_a: Unchanged. DevAdm_x does not redefine the context-indexed admissibility floor.
relationship_to_existing_symbols.AdmObs_x: AdmObs_x may be defined as a projection or wrapper over DevAdm_x only after an explicit mapping is approved; identity is not assumed.
relationship_to_existing_symbols.Excl_obs_x: Excl_obs_x may construct Omega_x_adm by retaining omega when DevAdm_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) = ADMISSIBLE.
relationship_to_existing_symbols.[Asym]_x: DevAdm_x does not itself create [Asym]_x; [Asym]_x remains a downstream symmetry-condition construction.
relationship_to_existing_symbols.<S>_x: DevAdm_x does not produce bounded symmetry directly.

chain_binding.formula: B_x, omega, D_rel -> DevAdm_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) -> Omega_x_adm -> DomOrient_x -> o_x -> [Asym]_x -> <S>_x
chain_binding.family_rule: omega in Omega_x_adm iff MemberOrient(omega, Omega_obs, >S<, D_rel) and DevAdm_x(B_x, omega, D_rel) = ADMISSIBLE
chain_binding.symmetry_guard: DevAdm_x evaluates orientation-conditioned deviation; it never excludes or negates >S<.
chain_binding.delta_alpha_guard: No delta_alpha input is required by this candidate signature.

failure_semantics.inadmissible_orientation: The candidate orientation is excluded from Omega_x_adm for the declared interaction and domain.
failure_semantics.undefined_evaluation: The result is UNDEFINED when required typing or constraints are absent.
failure_semantics.empty_family: If every omega is INADMISSIBLE, Omega_x_adm is empty and bounded realization fails locally; symmetry remains present.
failure_semantics.no_zero_inference: No result implies symmetry absence, ontological nothingness, or universal impossibility.

adversarial_tests.name: ADMISSIBLE_ORIENTATION
adversarial_tests.expected: A qualifying orientation returns ADMISSIBLE and remains in Omega_x_adm.

adversarial_tests.name: INADMISSIBLE_ORIENTATION
adversarial_tests.expected: A rejected orientation returns INADMISSIBLE and is excluded from Omega_x_adm.

adversarial_tests.name: UNDEFINED_INPUT
adversarial_tests.expected: Untyped B_x, omega, or D_rel returns UNDEFINED without repair.

adversarial_tests.name: NO_SYMMETRY_EXCLUSION
adversarial_tests.expected: Changing the result for omega never removes >S<.

adversarial_tests.name: MULTIPLE_ADMISSIBLE_ORIENTATIONS
adversarial_tests.expected: DevAdm_x classifies each orientation and does not select a dominant one.

adversarial_tests.name: DELTA_ALPHA_NON_COLLISION
adversarial_tests.expected: DevAdm_x remains distinct when delta_alpha is supplied under another governed signature.

adversarial_tests.name: EPSILON_FLOOR_NON_COLLISION
adversarial_tests.expected: DevAdm_x does not become identical to epsilon_a or any admissibility floor.

open_questions: What internal relation or metric, if any, evaluates orientation-conditioned deviation?
Is AdmissibilityResult Boolean, ordinal, or structured?
Is DevAdm_x a primitive evaluator, a domain-local predicate, or a wrapper around existing admissibility machinery?
Can AdmObs_x be formally derived from DevAdm_x without changing either signature?
How does residue enter DevAdm_x, if at all?
next_recommended_action: Human-review whether DevAdm_x should remain a named provisional predicate or be mapped to an existing governed admissibility surface.
